features.title: Cycle Time Optimization
features.body: Track production cycles at the crew level in real time. Identify bottlenecks instantly when output deviates from tolerance, and give site engineers an immediate view of whether pacing will meet daily objectives.

features.body: Connect production directly to specific project activities and BOQ cost heads. Material inputs and outputs are tracked against actual consumption, preventing uncontrolled cost overruns hidden in paper reports.

faqs.q: What is SiteFlow construction production management software?
faqs.a: It is a specialized module for contractors running in-house fabrication or material batching. It controls mix standardization, real-time batch recording, input versus output tracking, and production linkage to project cost heads.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow enforce approved material mix proportions?
faqs.a: Define standard mix proportions for every production type. When a batch is recorded it references the approved mix rather than relying on memory, and deviations outside tolerance are flagged.

Yes. Every production batch recorded in SiteFlow automatically updates the raw material inventory at the site where production occurred, so balances reflect current stock without manual ledger updates.
